subject: SOC 2 Type II - Request for report & acceptable evidence formats
messages:
From: Lena Rossi <lena.rossi@acme-corp.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and acceptable evidence formats

Hi Diego,

We're preparing our vendor security assessment for Q4 and would like to request a copy of Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II report covering production systems, plus guidance on what evidence you can reasonably share for controls testing. Specifically:

- Audit period covered by the report (start/end)
- Whether you can provide a bridge letter if the report sampling window doesn't align with our audit window
- A short list of evidence artifacts you can share (policy snapshots, retention/destruction logs, sample audit logs, config snapshots, etc.)

Our security team prefers a lightweight intake (SFTP or secure Drive link) and we can handle non-sensitive redaction on our side. Could you confirm the timeline and the preferred transfer method?

Thanks,
Lena Rossi
Security Program Manager
Acme Corporation

[Attachment: Acme_Security_Intake_Form.xlsx (xlsx, 32KB)]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Lena Rossi <lena.rossi@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Sep 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and acceptable evidence formats

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear ask. Happy to help and we can move quickly. Quick summary / options: 

1) Report delivery: we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report PDF for the covered period and an accompanying coverage matrix.

2) Audit period: our latest Type II covers 2024-07-01 through 2025-06-30. If that window doesn't match your needs we can:
   - Provide a bridge letter that attests to ongoing controls since the report end date (short-form) or
   - Share our upcoming audit timeline and, if requested, a limited telemetry snapshot aligned to your window under an NDA.

3) Evidence we typically provide (low-friction options):
   - Policy snapshots (Access Control, Change Management) — PDF
   - Retention / deletion schedule and sample deletion logs — CSV or PDF
   - Sample IAM config export (redacted) — JSON/CSV
   - Infrastructure change ticket snapshots (created/closed) — PDF exports
   - Redacted audit log slices (timestamps and operation types) — CSV (sample window)

Transfer options: pre-signed S3 links, secure Drive folder with limited access, or an SFTP drop. For sensitive telemetry we prefer S3 presigned links with short TTL.

I've attached a short checklist that shows minimal artifacts we can share without custom redaction. See attached: SOC2_TypeII_Minimums.pdf and a one-page transfer options guide.

If helpful, below is a one-line response template you can use to confirm next steps (I can also send directly):

---
Diego (template reply)
Hi Lena — thanks. Please share the audit window you need and confirm S3 presigned links or Drive. We will: 1) provide the Type II report and coverage matrix; 2) share the listed evidence artifacts (policy snapshots, sample logs, IAM export) via the chosen transfer method; 3) either provide a bridge letter or discuss a telemetry snapshot if needed. Expect initial deliverables within 3 business days after transfer confirmation.
---

Let me know which transfer method you prefer and the audit window you need.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Minimums.pdf (pdf, 68KB); evidence_transfer_options.md (text, 4KB)]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Sep 2025 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and acceptable evidence formats

FYI — Lena requested the report and some sample artifacts. I drafted the short bridge-letter language and a compact evidence bundle we can share without legal signoff (see below). Vivek — can you skim and OK the bridge phrasing? If we need legal, I'll loop them once you confirm.

Draft bridge letter (short form):
"Redwood Inference confirms that controls described in the attached SOC 2 Type II report (period: 2024-07-01 to 2025-06-30) have continued to operate through the date of this letter, and no material changes to control design affecting control objectives have occurred since the report end date."

Compact evidence bundle (no PII, no raw audio/video):
- Access Control policy (PDF)
- Change Management policy (PDF)
- Sample retention/deletion schedule + redacted deletion log (CSV)
- Redacted IAM export (CSV)
- Coverage matrix (PDF)

One-line approval request: "Vivek — OK to send along as-is and attach the short bridge letter?"

Thanks,
Monica
Director, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Lena Rossi <lena.rossi@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Sep 2025 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report and acceptable evidence formats

Hi Lena — quick follow-up and next steps. We can proceed with the lightweight bundle and bridge letter. Proposed plan: 

1) Transfer method: S3 presigned links (48-hour TTL). Please confirm this is acceptable.
2) Audit window you requested: please confirm whether you need coverage aligned to Q3 2025; if so, we will provide a redacted telemetry snapshot under a short DPA amendment.
3) Delivery timeline: once you confirm transfer method and audit window, expect: Type II report + coverage matrix + compact evidence bundle + short bridge letter within 3 business days.

Attached are the items we will share (sample names): SOC2_TypeII_Report_2024-07_2025-06.pdf, Coverage_Matrix_20250630.pdf, AccessControl_Policy.pdf, ChangeMgmt_Policy.pdf, Retention_Log_Sample.csv, IAM_Export_Redacted.csv, BridgeLetter_Short.docx

If you prefer, you can reply with the single line: "Confirm S3 presigned links and we need coverage for 2025-07-01 to 2025-09-30." and we'll start the transfer.

Best regards,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: BridgeLetter_Short.docx (docx, 12KB)]
